contradiction_resolution: No claim-level contradiction: contradicts_claim_ids is empty, and the statement does not oppose CONJ-0001, THM-0001–THM-0007, OBS-0001, or RED-0001. It is compatible with the C66-001-v4 bottleneck instruction to model ordered distinct reduced divisors as a finite etale S_6-cover of the reduced-support open (and not to call that open closed), and with corroborated siblings FND-0052 (reduced-support relative linear-system piece is open, not a closed pure-codimension-4 subvariety of M_{6,6}) and FND-0053 (rational irreps of S_6 do not force Tate local systems on an S_6-cover). Independent primary check. For a smooth proper family of curves π:C→B and n≥1, the relative ordered configuration stack Conf_n(C/B) of n distinct sections maps by forgetting order to the relative symmetric product Sym^n(C/B) (relative effective divisors of degree n). Over the open locus U_red of reduced-support/simple divisors, geometric fibers are the n! orderings of n distinct points; S_n acts freely and transitively, and the morphism is finite locally free of degree n! with empty discriminant, hence finite etale (Stacks Project Tag 0BJF; etale local models Tag 02GH). Thus Conf_n→U_red is a finite etale S_n-torsor. Specializing to n=6 and B=B^{bal} (balanced tetragonal base for g=6) yields exactly the claimed S_6-torsor. Scope sharpening only: (i) ‘relative effective-divisor space’ means Sym^6(C/B^{bal}), not automatically the relative complete linear system |L| with L=W_5⊗ω_C^{-1}; when the failure locus is modelled inside |L| via O_C(Γ)≅L (FND-0063), the ordering cover remains an S_6-torsor over the reduced-support open of that divisor space, but constructing the relative target as Proj(π_*L) requires the cohomology-and-base-change care of FND-0047 when h^0 jumps; (ii) the map is a torsor over U_red only—Conf_6 does not dominate non-reduced divisors; (iii) the torsor structure alone does not control monodromy or Tate type of local systems on configuration/linear-system spaces (FND-0053). Distinct from FND-0052 (open-vs-closed failure locus in M_{6,6}) and FND-0053 (Tate failure for S_6-covers): do not merge. Merge target: none. Promote from candidate to corroborated; evidence_class upgraded from adversarial_review to primary_source on independent classical finite-etale/torsor verification and packet-primary CE context (SRC-0004).
